p3_b0.ocr: In the New Product Launch Pipeline, the overview details five products with varying sales performance, units sold, and projected growth. p3_b1.ocr: The second product, Beef Jerky, launches in Q3 2024, with a sales volume of 900,000 units and an 8% market share, expecting Year 1 sales of £10M, Year 2 sales of £14M, Year 3 sales of £20M, Year 4 sales of £27M, and Year 5 sales of £33M, achieving a CAGR of 19.0%.
